description: This file defines an abstract class 'ModelWidget' which serves as a base class for widget model classes in the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes properties for widget identification, boundary comment control, and methods for retrieving widget metadata and configuration.

classes.name: ModelWidget
classes.description: An abstract base class for widget models, providing properties and methods for widget metadata, boundary comments, and border display configuration.

classes.name: ModelWidget.NamedBorderType
classes.description: An enum defining types of named borders for development purposes: NONE, LABEL, SOURCE.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Abstract method to accept a visitor implementing ModelWidgetVisitor.

methods.name: getSystemId
methods.description: Returns the URL or identifier where the widget was defined.

methods.name: getStartColumn
methods.description: Returns the column number where the widget is defined in its XML file.

methods.name: getStartLine
methods.description: Returns the line number where the widget is defined in its XML file.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the widget, using an XmlWidgetVisitor.

methods.name: getBoundaryCommentName
methods.description: Returns the name used in boundary comments, defaulting to the widget's name.

methods.name: widgetBoundaryCommentsEnabled
methods.description: Determines if widget boundary comments are enabled based on properties and context.

methods.name: widgetNamedBorderType
methods.description: Determines the type of named border for development based on properties.
